command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
# Open MPI refuses to run as root without these, and a container runs as root; omitting
# them kills the ranks with no useful message.
export OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT=1 OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT_CONFIRM=1
export OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none
# One OpenMP thread per rank: PETSc/BLAS threading on top of MPI would make the
# serial-vs-parallel comparison a different experiment.
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
cd /tmp
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).

echo "== staged bytes must match their pin =="
sha256sum -c pins.sha256 || { echo "FAIL: identities.py does not match its pin"; exit 1; }

echo "== serial pass =="
EXPECTED_RANKS=1 python3 -u identities.py 2>&1 | tee serial.log
S1="${PIPESTATUS[0]}"

echo "== 2-rank pass, which also cross-checks against the serial results =="
EXPECTED_RANKS=2 mpiexec -n 2 python3 -u identities.py 2>&1 | tee par.log
S2="${PIPESTATUS[0]}"

cat serial.log par.log > identities.log
test "$S1" = "0" || { echo "FAIL: the serial pass failed"; exit 1; }
test "$S2" = "0" || { echo "FAIL: the 2-rank pass failed"; exit 1; }
grep -q "comm_size\|mpi_comm_world_size" par.log || { echo "FAIL: no rank count reported"; exit 1; }

uname -m | awk '{print "arch\t"$1}'
echo "DONE"
